[Update June 3rd, 2025] New German names [Update June 2nd, 2025] New chart for INT scaling for the scientist perks

With the upcoming update (Patch 60) on June 3rd, 2025, a new season will start again. Season 21 is all about the theme of the update: fishing. But it's not just fishing that's new. There are also numerous balancing and perk card changes.

Here you can find an overview.

Changed perk cards

Adrenaline

+10% damage per kill during a killstreak (max. 10).

Rank 1: Additional +10% damage for 30 seconds per kill. Duration is reset on kills.

Only 1 rank left.

Adrenaline (Patch 59)

Adrenaline (from patch 60)

Quickly dodged

+5% chance to dodge. Dodge no longer has a cooldown and instead costs AP.

Points cost increased from 1 to 2

Developer Note: AP cost is 10x the cooldown. The cooldown scales with the damage avoided, i.e. h. Higher damage attacks cost more AP to dodge. If you don't have enough AP to pay for the dodge, it can't be done.

Ranks 2 and 3 removed

No power armor

Not overloaded

Quickly Dodged (Patch 59)

Quickly dodged (from patch 60)

With emphasis

Small firearms have a 5% chance to stagger enemies and deal +25% body part damage.

Small firearms have a 10% chance to stagger enemies and deal +50% body part damage.

Small firearms have a 15% chance to stagger enemies and deal +75% body part damage.

Small Firearms: Rifles, Pistols & Shotguns

With Vigor (Patch 59)

With emphasis (from patch 60)

Goat legs

You do not suffer any damage from falls.

Rank 2 removed

Workshop traps no longer require defenders

You gain a +10% chance to dodge attacks while sprinting. (No power armor)

You gain a +15% chance to dodge attacks while sprinting. (No power armor)

Moving target (from patch 60)

Travel Advisor

You can fast travel while overcharged at an increased cost.

Depends on how overloaded you are

2x carrying weight = ~25.75x cost

3x carrying weight = ~50.5x cost

4x carrying weight = ~75.25x cost

5x carrying weight = ~100x cost

Up to 6000 bottle caps
